youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的機場行李丟失情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從轉盤苦等、到申報處描述行李填單、買臨時用品保留收據、直到行李送達核對破損與理賠，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Lost Luggage phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the whole airport journey: waiting at the carousel, filing the report, buying emergency essentials with receipts, and the delivery, damage check and compensation. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is this the baggage claim?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈbæɡɪdʒ kleɪm/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，這裡是行李提取區嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your flight's bags come here.
dialogue.zh: 對，您那班機的行李會到這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does baggage usually take?
dialogue.zh: 提取行李一般要等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About fifteen minutes after landing.
dialogue.zh: 降落後大約十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We landed almost an hour ago.
dialogue.zh: 我們降落快一個小時了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a little too long.
dialogue.zh: 那確實有點太久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The belt moves, but no bag appears.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛlt muːvz bʌt noʊ bæɡ əˈpɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 傳送帶在轉，卻不見我的箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the flight status now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə flaɪt ˈstætəs naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在查一下航班狀態。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please check, I am getting worried.
dialogue.zh: 請查一下吧，我有點擔心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, your bag is not on the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm jʊr bæɡ ɪz nɑt ɑn ðə lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，清單上沒有您的行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not on the list? What does that mean?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɑn ðə lɪst wʌt dʌz ðæt miːn/
dialogue.zh: 清單上沒有？那是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It may have missed the last flight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt meɪ hæv mɪst ðə læst flaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 它可能錯過了最後一班飛機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Missed the flight? Is that common?
dialogue.zh: 錯過飛機？這種事常見嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes bags stay behind at connections.
dialogue.zh: 有時行李會滯留在轉機地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My suitcase is large and dark blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsuːtˌkeɪs ɪz lɑːrdʒ ænd dɑːrk bluː/
dialogue.zh: 我的行李箱又大又是深藍色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it have wheels and a handle?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt hæv wiːlz ænd ə ˈhændəl/
dialogue.zh: 它有輪子和拉桿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, four wheels and a pull handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fɔːr wiːlz ænd ə pʊl ˈhændəl/
dialogue.zh: 對，四個輪子還有拉桿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any special marks or stickers?
dialogue.zh: 有什麼特別的記號或貼紙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a red ribbon on the zipper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə rɛd ˈrɪbən ɑn ðə ˈzɪpər/
dialogue.zh: 拉鏈上繫了一條紅絲帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, that ribbon will help us spot it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ðæt ˈrɪbən wɪl hɛlp ʌs spɑːt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那條絲帶能幫我們認出它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep waiting at this carousel?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kiːp ˈweɪtɪŋ æt ðɪs ˌkærəˈsɛl/
dialogue.zh: 我還要在這個轉盤等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait fifteen more minutes, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt fɪfˈtiːn mɔːr ˈmɪnɪts dʒʌst ɪn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 再等十五分鐘，以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will watch the belt a bit longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ wɪl wɑːtʃ ðə bɛlt ə bɪt ˈlɔːŋɡər/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我再盯一會兒傳送帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will stay nearby if you need me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl steɪ ˈnɪrˌbaɪ ɪf ju niːd miː/
dialogue.zh: 需要的話我就在附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes passed and nothing came out.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts pæst ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ keɪm aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 過了十分鐘，還是什麼都沒有出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then your bag is truly not here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jʊr bæɡ ɪz ˈtruːli nɑt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 那您的行李真的不在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it really is lost?
dialogue.zh: 所以它真的丟了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us say delayed for now.
dialogue.zh: 我們暫且說是延遲送達。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I do first?
dialogue.zh: 我該先做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: File a report at the airline desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪl ə rɪˈpɔːrt æt ði ˈɛrˌlaɪn dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 到航空公司櫃台填一份報告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly is that desk?
dialogue.zh: 那個櫃台確切在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right past exit seven, on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt pæst ˈɛɡzɪt ˈsɛvən ɑn ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 穿過七號出口，就在左邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a long line over there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə lɔːŋ laɪn ˈoʊvər ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那裡排隊的人多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually not this late at night.
dialogue.zh: 這麼晚了通常不會多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. I just want to finish tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ dʒʌst wɑːnt tu ˈfɪnɪʃ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 還好。我只希望今晚能處理完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The form only takes ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 填表只要十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need any papers with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː aɪ niːd ˈɛni ˈpeɪpərz wɪð miː/
dialogue.zh: 我需要帶什麼單據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your boarding pass and baggage stubs.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ jʊr ˈbɔːrdɪŋ pæs ænd ˈbæɡɪdʒ stʌbz/
dialogue.zh: 請帶登機證和行李票根。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I kept the small paper stubs safely.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kɛpt ðə smɔːl ˈpeɪpər stʌbz ˈseɪfli/
dialogue.zh: 小紙票根我都好好收著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, those numbers track your bag.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那些編號能追蹤行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone battery is almost dead.
dialogue.zh: 我手機快沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Charging stations sit near the food court.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɑːrdʒɪŋ ˈsteɪʃənz sɪt nɪr ðə fud kɔːrt/
dialogue.zh: 充電站在美食街附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will grab juice and wait there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ɡræb dʒuːs ænd weɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我先買杯果汁在那邊等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds good; I will meet you at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡʊd aɪ wɪl miːt ju æt ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 好的，我們櫃台那邊碰面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these things happen often here?
dialogue.zh: 在這裡常有這種事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few bags go missing every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fjuː bæɡz ɡoʊ ˈmɪsɪŋ ˈɛvri deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 每天都會有幾件行李找不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are most of them found again?
dialogue.zh: 大部分都能再找回來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, almost ninety percent return home.
dialogue.zh: 是的，幾乎九成都會送回。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me feel a little better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪks miː fiːl ə ˈlɪtəl ˈbɛtər/
dialogue.zh: 這樣說我就放心一點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep hope; yours has a clear tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiːp hoʊp jʊrz hæz ə klɪr tæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 保持希望；你的標籤很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I check online if it moves?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tʃɛk ˌɑnˈlaɪn ɪf ɪt muːvz/
dialogue.zh: 我能在網上查它的動向嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The reference number gives live tracking.
dialogue.zh: 有參考編號就能即時追蹤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What reference number? Is that on the form?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈrɛfərəns ˈnʌmbər ɪz ðæt ɑn ðə fɔːrm/
dialogue.zh: 什麼參考編號？是單子上的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You get one after filing the report.
dialogue.phonetic: /juː ɡɛt wʌn ˈæftər ˈfaɪlɪŋ ðə rɪˈpɔːrt/
dialogue.zh: 填完報告你就會拿到一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will someone call me when it arrives?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ˈsʌmˌwʌn kɔːl miː wɛn ɪt əˈraɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 它到的時候會有人打給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, staff will call the number you give.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs stæf wɪl kɔːl ðə ˈnʌmbər juː ɡɪv/
dialogue.zh: 會，工作人員會打你留的電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only have my mobile number.
dialogue.zh: 我只有手機號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is fine; answer unknown numbers too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz faɪn ˈænsər ənˈnoʊn ˈnʌmbərz tuː/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題；陌生號碼也要接。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will not turn my phone off.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl nɑːt tɜːrn maɪ foʊn ɔːf/
dialogue.zh: 我不會把手機關機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thinking; calls may come late.
dialogue.zh: 想得對；電話可能很晚才來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight I have no clean clothes.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我沒有乾淨衣服可換。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The desk can give you an emergency kit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɛsk kæn ɡɪv juː ən ɪˈmɜːrdʒənsi kɪt/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台可以給你一份應急用品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An emergency kit? What is inside?
dialogue.zh: 應急用品包？裡面有什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Basic things like a toothbrush and socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbeɪsɪk θɪŋz laɪk ə ˈtuːθbrʌʃ ænd sɑːks/
dialogue.zh: 牙刷、襪子之類的基本用品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for that kit?
dialogue.zh: 那個用品包要錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is free for delayed luggage.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ɪz friː fɔːr dɪˈleɪd ˈlʌɡɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 不用，行李延誤免費提供。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful, my toiletries are all lost.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的洗漱用品全丟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will also get money for essentials.
dialogue.phonetic: /juː wɪl ˈɔːlsoʊ ɡɛt ˈmʌni fɔːr ɪˈsɛnʃəlz/
dialogue.zh: 你還會拿到一筆買必需品的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Money? How does that work?
dialogue.zh: 錢？那是怎麼運作的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy what you need, keep the receipts.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ wʌt juː niːd kiːp ðə rɪˈsiːts/
dialogue.zh: 買你需要的，收據留好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every store here gives paper receipts.
dialogue.zh: 這邊每家店都會給紙收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photos of receipts are okay too.
dialogue.zh: 收據拍照也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I buy very expensive things?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ baɪ ˈvɛri ɪkˈspɛnsɪv θɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 如果我買很貴的東西呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a daily spending limit.
dialogue.zh: 每天消費有上限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the limit tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚的上限是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around sixty dollars for this airport.
dialogue.zh: 這個機場大約六十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That covers a shirt and some medicine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈkʌvərz ə ʃɜːrt ænd sʌm ˈmɛdəsən/
dialogue.zh: 那夠買件衣服和一點藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medicine first, please; health comes before clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛdəsən fɜːrst pliːz hɛlθ kʌmz bɪˈfɔːr kloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 先買藥；健康比衣服要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I must take my pills tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我今晚一定要吃藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the pharmacy near the arrivals door.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðə ˈfɑːrməsi nɪr ði əˈraɪvəlz dɔːr/
dialogue.zh: 去到達門附近的藥局問問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they open that late at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðeɪ ˈoʊpən ðæt leɪt æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他們半夜還開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the airport pharmacy stays open all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ði ˈɛrˌpɔːrt ˈfɑːrməsi steɪz ˈoʊpən ɔːl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 開著，機場藥局整夜營業。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. I feel calmer already.
dialogue.zh: 完美，我已經平靜多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Now let us head to the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ lɛt ʌs hɛd tu ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 好，我們現在往櫃台走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we walk or take the train?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː wiː wɔːk ɔːr teɪk ðə treɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我們是走路還是搭乘接駁車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walking is faster; it is just outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔːkɪŋ ɪz ˈfæstər ɪt ɪz dʒʌst ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 走路更快；就在外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you help me at the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl juː hɛlp miː æt ðə ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 待會在櫃台你會幫我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will walk you through it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ wɪl wɔːk juː θruː ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 會，我會帶著你一步一步辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last worry: my camera lens.
dialogue.zh: 最後一個擔心：我的相機鏡頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lenses belong in hand luggage, my friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛnzəz bɪˈlɔːŋ ɪn hænd ˈlʌɡɪdʒ maɪ frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 鏡頭該放隨身行李的，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know, I was careless at packing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ aɪ wʌz ˈkɛrləs æt ˈpækɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我知道，收拾時我太馬虎了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lesson learned for every future trip.
dialogue.zh: 這次教訓，往後旅行記住就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you think it is already in transit?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː juː θɪŋk ɪt ɪz ɔːlˈrɛdi ɪn ˈtrænzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你覺得它已經在運送了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Likely yes; scanned bags move fast.
dialogue.zh: 很可能；掃過碼的行李走得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see those scans on a website?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ siː ðoʊz skænz ɑːn ə ˈwɛbˌsaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我能在網站上看到掃描記錄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The desk will show you the page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɛsk wɪl ʃoʊ juː ðə peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台會讓你看那個頁面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, let us go before lines grow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt lɛt ʌs ɡoʊ bɪˈfɔːr laɪnz ɡroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，趁隊伍變長前快走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lead the way; I will grab my notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /liːd ðə weɪ aɪ wɪl ɡræb maɪ noʊts/
dialogue.zh: 你帶路；我拿上我的記錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for taking this seriously.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你認真處理這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Your trip should not be ruined.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm jʊr trɪp ʃʊd nɑːt biː ˈruːɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，不該讓這趟旅行被毀了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, my bag never came around.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我的行李一直沒有轉出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hello, may I see your boarding pass?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ meɪ aɪ siː jʊr ˈbɔːrdɪŋ pæs/
dialogue.zh: 您好，能看一下登機證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, with the baggage stubs.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz wɪð ðə ˈbæɡɪdʒ stʌbz/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，還有行李票根。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, one large checked bag?
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，是一件託運大行李對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, blue, hard shell, twenty-eight inches.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bluː hɑːrd ʃɛl ˈtwɛnti eɪt ˈɪnʧəz/
dialogue.zh: 對，藍色硬殼，二十八吋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any scratches or dents on it?
dialogue.zh: 上面有刮痕或凹痕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small dent near the bottom corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔːl dɛnt nɪr ðə ˈbɑːtəm ˈkɔːrnər/
dialogue.zh: 底部角落有一個小凹陷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That helps staff recognize your bag.
dialogue.zh: 那能幫工作人員認出您的行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It also has a black wheel cover.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈɔːlsoʊ hæz ə blæk wiːl ˈkʌvər/
dialogue.zh: 它還有一個黑色的輪套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What brand is the suitcase?
dialogue.zh: 行李箱是什麼牌子的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is a Travelite, older model.
dialogue.zh: 是 Travelite 牌，舊款的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I write: older blue Travelite.
dialogue.zh: 好，我寫：舊款藍色 Travelite。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you find my bag in the photos?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju faɪnd maɪ bæɡ ɪn ðə ˈfoʊtoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 照片裡有找到我的箱子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet; many blue cases look alike.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt ˈmɛni bluː ˈkeɪsəz lʊk əˈlaɪk/
dialogue.zh: 還沒有；照片裡很多藍箱子長得很像。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The red ribbon is my best mark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd ˈrɪbən ɪz maɪ bɛst mɑːrk/
dialogue.zh: 紅絲帶是我最明顯的記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I add it to the description now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æd ɪt tuː ðə dɪˈskrɪpʃən naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在把它寫進描述裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The form looks long and detailed.
dialogue.zh: 這張表格看起來又長又細。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with your name and flight number.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑːrt wɪð jʊr neɪm ænd flaɪt ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 先填你的名字和航班號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my address the hotel tonight?
dialogue.zh: 地址就填今晚住的飯店嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus your mobile number below.
dialogue.zh: 對，下面再填手機號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Now the contents section.
dialogue.zh: 填好了。現在是物品那欄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: List clothes, shoes, and personal items.
dialogue.zh: 列出衣服、鞋子和私人物品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two pairs of shoes, mostly summer clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː pɛrz əv ʃuːz ˈmoʊstli ˈsʌmər kloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 兩雙鞋，大多是夏天的衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anything expensive inside the case?
dialogue.zh: 箱子裡還有貴重的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No jewelry, only a cheap watch.
dialogue.zh: 沒有珠寶，只有一塊便宜的手錶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A watch should ride in your pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɑːtʃ ʃʊd raɪd ɪn jʊr ˈpɑːkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 手錶應該放在你的口袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a camera with two lenses.
dialogue.zh: 還有一台相機和兩個鏡頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a payout cap for cameras.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈpeɪˌaʊt kæp fɔːr ˈkæmərəz/
dialogue.zh: 相機的賠付有上限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is that cap exactly?
dialogue.zh: 那個上限具體是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five hundred dollars per checked bag.
dialogue.zh: 每件託運行李五百美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My camera cost more than that.
dialogue.zh: 我那台相機比這還貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A receipt shows its real price.
dialogue.zh: 收據能顯示它的真實價格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bought it years ago, sadly.
dialogue.zh: 可惜那是好幾年前買的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we estimate by current value.
dialogue.zh: 那我們照現在的價值估算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, write: used camera, good shape.
dialogue.zh: 好，寫：舊相機，成色不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted, anything else inside?
dialogue.zh: 記下了，裡面還有別的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some books and my daughter's drawing.
dialogue.zh: 幾本書，還有女兒畫的畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drawings have no cash value, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，畫作沒有現金價值。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is only sentimental for me.
dialogue.zh: 那對我只有感情上的意義。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will still look for everything.
dialogue.zh: 但我們還是會盡量把它找齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please also note the toiletry bag.
dialogue.zh: 也請註明那個洗漱包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A zip bag with shampoo and cream?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə zɪp bæɡ wɪð ʃæmˈpuː ænd krim/
dialogue.zh: 拉鏈袋裡是洗髮精和乳霜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, plus medicine in a small jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌs ˈmɛdəsən ɪn ə smɔːl dʒɑːr/
dialogue.zh: 對，還有一小罐藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which medicine? I must record it.
dialogue.zh: 什麼藥？我必須記錄下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blood pressure pills, one small bottle.
dialogue.zh: 降壓藥，一小瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good; the pharmacy can handle that.
dialogue.zh: 好，藥局能處理那種藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this report called a PIR?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs rɪˈpɔːrt kɔːld ə ˌpiː aɪ ˈɑːr/
dialogue.zh: 這份報告叫 PIR 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a property irregularity report.
dialogue.zh: 對，行李不正常運輸報告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fancy name for a bad night.
dialogue.zh: 名字挺正式，這一夜可真糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, but it works; most files close fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /truː bʌt ɪt wɜːrks moʊst faɪlz kloʊz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 是，但它有用，多數案子很快結。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sign here, and then here again?
dialogue.zh: 在這裡簽名，然後這裡再簽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the bottom line, please.
dialogue.zh: 請只在最下面那一行簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a printed name okay instead?
dialogue.zh: 用列印的名字行不行？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we need your handwritten signature.
dialogue.zh: 不行，需要您手寫的簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, done twice now.
dialogue.zh: 好了，這下簽了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I stamp the copy for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk juː aɪ stæmp ðə ˈkɑːpi fɔːr juː/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我蓋章後給你副本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A copy? I should keep that?
dialogue.zh: 副本？這個我也要收好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it safe; it proves your claim.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiːp ɪt seɪf ɪt pruːvz jʊr kleɪm/
dialogue.zh: 收好，它能證明你的申報。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what is my reference number?
dialogue.zh: 那我的參考編號是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: B-A-U-A, then seven digits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌbiː ˌeɪ ˌjuː ˈeɪ ðɛn ˈsɛvən ˈdɪdʒɪts/
dialogue.zh: 字母 BAUA，再加七位數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me photograph it right now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在就把它拍下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And write it on your hand too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd raɪt ɪt ɑːn jʊr hænd tuː/
dialogue.zh: 也寫在你的手掌上吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With this number, I can track it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ðɪs ˈnʌmbər aɪ kæn træk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有了這個編號就能追蹤了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, on our site, twice a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɑːn aʊr saɪt twaɪs ə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，在我們網站上，一天更新兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the website address again?
dialogue.zh: 網站地址能再說一遍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will text it to your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tɛkst ɪt tuː jʊr foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我把簡訊發到你手機上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Will staff also call me?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。工作人員也會打給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the moment your bag is found.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈmoʊmənt jʊr bæɡ ɪz faʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 會，一找到您的行李就打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who actually searches for my bag?
dialogue.zh: 到底是誰在實際找我的行李？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The baggage office at every station.
dialogue.zh: 每個站點的行李處都會找。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could it already be in this city?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ɪt ɔːlˈrɛdi biː ɪn ðɪs ˈsɪti/
dialogue.zh: 它會不會已經在這個城市了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very likely; it arrived on a later flight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri ˈlaɪkli ɪt əˈraɪvd ɑːn ə ˈleɪtər flaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 很可能；它搭後一班機到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then why does nobody know yet?
dialogue.zh: 那為什麼還沒人知道？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scanning takes time; give it one night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈskænɪŋ teɪks taɪm ɡɪv ɪt wʌn naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 掃描要時間；再給它一晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I will sleep and hope.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我先去睡，抱著希望。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best plan right now, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，這是現在最好的打算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing about customs.
dialogue.zh: 還有一件關於海關的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask me; I handle those forms too.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk miː aɪ ˈhændəl ðoʊz fɔːrmz tuː/
dialogue.zh: 問吧，那些單子我也辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I declare the lost bag again?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː aɪ dɪˈklɛr ðə lɔːst bæɡ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我需要再申報一次丟失的行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This report is your declaration already.
dialogue.zh: 這份報告就已經是你的申報。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, one less task tonight.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，今晚少一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the form for customs at home, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiːp ðə fɔːrm fɔːr ˈkʌstəmz æt hoʊm tuː/
dialogue.zh: 回國過海關時也要留好單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The desk copy goes in my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɛsk ˈkɑːpi ɡoʊz ɪn maɪ ˈpɑːkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台給的副本我放進口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then nothing can fall out.
dialogue.zh: 好，這樣就不會弄掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, my hotel shuttle leaves at eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ hoʊˈtɛl ˈʃʌtl liːvz æt ɪˈlɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 我的飯店班車十一點發車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then go now; the desk is finished.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡoʊ naʊ ðə dɛsk ɪz ˈfɪnɪʃt/
dialogue.zh: 那快去吧，手續辦完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was it, honestly, that simple?
dialogue.zh: 說實話，就這麼簡單？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Simple now, done right; that is the trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl naʊ dʌn raɪt ðæt ɪz ðə trɪk/
dialogue.zh: 現在辦對就簡單，訣竅就在這。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I eat something near here?
dialogue.zh: 這附近能吃點東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two doors down, the noodle shop is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː dɔːrz daʊn ðə ˈnudəl ʃɑːp ɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 隔兩家門面，麵店還開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know this airport better than signs.
dialogue.phonetic: /juː noʊ ðɪs ˈɛrˌpɔːrt ˈbɛtər ðæn saɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 你比指示牌還熟這個機場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten years here will do that.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡待上十年誰不熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope your team finds my blue case.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp jʊr tiːm faɪndz maɪ bluː keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我希望你們團隊能找到我的藍箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will try hard tonight, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /wiː wɪl traɪ hɑːrd təˈnaɪt aɪ ˈprɑːmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們會盡力，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if tonight brings no luck?
dialogue.zh: 要是今晚運氣不好呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then tomorrow brings news, usually.
dialogue.zh: 那通常明天就會帶來消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow is Friday. I fly Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 明天週五，我週日起飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we have a weekend to find it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wiː hæv ə ˈwiːkˌɛnd tu faɪnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們還有整個週末可找。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will trust you and sleep now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl trʌst juː ænd sliːp naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我就相信你，現在去睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well; I will watch the file tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /sliːp wɛl aɪ wɪl wɑːtʃ ðə faɪl təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 睡好點，今晚我盯著這個案子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, I need a pharmacy.
dialogue.zh: 早安，我需要一家藥局。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are standing inside one already.
dialogue.zh: 您已經站在一家裡面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect! I lost all my medicine.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我的藥全丟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it easy; what pills do you need?
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt ˈiːzi wɑːt pɪlz du juː niːd/
dialogue.zh: 別急，您需要什麼藥？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blood pressure pills, once a day.
dialogue.zh: 降壓藥，一天吃一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, a fresh sealed box.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr juː ɡoʊ ə frɛʃ siːld bɑːks/
dialogue.zh: 給您，全新未拆封的一盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is it, please?
dialogue.zh: 請問這多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fourteen fifty, receipt included.
dialogue.zh: 十四塊五，附收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I also get a toothbrush?
dialogue.zh: 還能給我一支牙刷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two packs, or just one today?
dialogue.zh: 拿兩組，還是今天就一組？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One is fine, my bag may return.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɪz faɪn maɪ bæɡ meɪ rɪˈtɜːrn/
dialogue.zh: 一支就好，說不定行李會回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart; travel sizes save your money.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，旅行裝更省錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell deodorant and soap?
dialogue.zh: 你們賣除臭劑和肥皂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both are near the shampoo.
dialogue.zh: 賣，都在洗髮精旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take soap, deodorant, cream.
dialogue.zh: 肥皂、除臭劑、乳霜我都要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anything for shaving today?
dialogue.zh: 今天要買刮鬍的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, a small razor and gel.
dialogue.zh: 要，一個小刮刀和凝膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the whole wash kit, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə hoʊl wɑʃ kɪt aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 這樣洗漱一應俱全了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also painkillers; my back aches badly.
dialogue.zh: 還要止痛藥，我背疼得厲害。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The top shelf, and drink water.
dialogue.zh: 在最上層貨架，記得多喝水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cash or card today?
dialogue.zh: 今天付現金還是刷卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card is fine; keep the receipt slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑːrd ɪz faɪn kiːp ðə rɪˈsiːt slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡就行，收據條留好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I take a photo of every slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ˈɛvri slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 每張收據我都拍照存證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The airline likes those photos too.
dialogue.zh: 航空公司也喜歡那些照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I need dry socks, badly.
dialogue.zh: 現在我急著要乾淨襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The store downstairs sells socks and shirts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stɔːr ˌdaʊnˈstɛərz sɛlz sɑːks ænd ʃɜːrts/
dialogue.zh: 樓下商店有襪子和襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At the store now, one pack of socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðə stɔːr naʊ wʌn pæk əv sɑːks/
dialogue.zh: 我現在到商店了，要一組襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Underwear is beside them, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndərˈwɛr ɪz bɪˈsaɪd ðɛm baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 說來，內衣就在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I lost underwear too, so yes.
dialogue.zh: 內衣也丟了，所以正需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take three pairs, enough for days.
dialogue.zh: 拿三件吧，夠穿幾天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And one T-shirt, gray if possible.
dialogue.zh: 再要一件T恤，有灰色的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium gray, here you are.
dialogue.zh: 中碼灰色，給您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I buy too many things?
dialogue.zh: 我買得太多了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, all are on the basics list.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɔːl ɑːr ɑːn ðə ˈbeɪsɪks lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，都是清單上的基本品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about a cheap rain jacket?
dialogue.zh: 那件便宜的雨衣外套呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain jackets are okay, keep proof.
dialogue.zh: 雨衣可以，留好憑證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty dollars for a raincoat here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡一件雨衣要二十美元？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Airport prices; claim it all later.
dialogue.zh: 機場價，事後都能報銷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am learning this system fast.
dialogue.zh: 我學這套制度學得飛快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lost luggage makes quick students.
dialogue.zh: 丟過行李的人都上手快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, hotel front desk? I checked in late.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ hoʊˈtɛl frʌnt dɛsk aɪ tʃɛkt ɪn leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 喂，飯店前台嗎？我昨晚很晚入住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, how may I help you today?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs haʊ meɪ aɪ hɛlp juː təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是我，今天需要什麼幫忙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My luggage is lost; no clean clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlʌɡɪdʒ ɪz lɔːst noʊ kliːn kloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 我行李丟了，沒有乾淨衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, then our laundry service can help.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɛn ˈaʊər ˈlɔːndri ˈsɜːrvɪs kæn hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那我們的洗衣服務能幫你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I only have yesterday's shirt.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我只有昨天穿過的襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same-day wash until ten a.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm deɪ wɑːʃ ənˈtɪl tɛn ˌeɪ ˈɛm/
dialogue.zh: 上午十點前送洗，當天可取。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you wash one shirt and socks?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn juː wɑːʃ wʌn ʃɜːrt ænd sɑːks/
dialogue.zh: 能洗一件襯衫和襪子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, put the bag outside your door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pʊt ðə bæɡ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd jʊr dɔːr/
dialogue.zh: 可以，把袋子放在房門外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the express wash?
dialogue.zh: 加急洗衣服務多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine dollars, back by six p.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈdɑːlərz bæk baɪ sɪks ˌpiː ˈɛm/
dialogue.zh: 九美元，下午六點送回。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you stamp receipts for the airline?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː juː stæmp rɪˈsiːts fɔːr ði ˈɛrˌlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你們收據會蓋章給航空公司看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we stamp every hotel receipt.
dialogue.zh: 會，每張飯店收據我們都蓋章。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That stamp helps my claim a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt stæmp hɛlps maɪ kleɪm ə lɑːt/
dialogue.zh: 那個章對我的理賠幫助很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask us for a letter if needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ʌs fɔːr ə ˈlɛtər ɪf ˈniːdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 需要的話也能找我們開證明信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A letter from the hotel? Why?
dialogue.zh: 飯店開的信？為什麼要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It proves you truly needed those things.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt pruːvz juː ˈtruːli ˈniːdɪd ðoʊz θɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 它能證明你確實需要那些東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please prepare one, just in case.
dialogue.zh: 請先準備一份，以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will wait at the desk today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl weɪt æt ðə dɛsk təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天會放在前台等你拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have one more favor to ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv wʌn mɔːr ˈfeɪvər tu æsk/
dialogue.zh: 我還有件事想麻煩你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course; our job is helping guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔːrs aʊr dʒɑːb ɪz ˈhɛlpɪŋ ɡɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 當然，照顧房客是我們的本職。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I check out, where do bags go?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ tʃɛk aʊt wɛr duː bæɡz ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 如果我退房，送來的行李怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hold them till your trip ends.
dialogue.phonetic: /wiː hoʊld ðɛm tɪl jʊr trɪp ɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 我們會代收保管到行程結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if the airline ships them home?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ði ˈɛrˌlaɪn ʃɪps ðɛm hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 那如果航空公司直接送我回家呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They need your home address first.
dialogue.zh: 那他們會先要你家裡的地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I give that address today?
dialogue.zh: 我今天就要把地址給了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you want it shipped home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf juː wɑːnt ɪt ʃɪpt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 想寄回家的話才給。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife can receive a box there.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf kæn rɪˈsiv ə bɑːks ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我太太在家能收包裹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then tell the airline your new plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tɛl ði ˈɛrˌlaɪn jʊr nuː plæn/
dialogue.zh: 那就把新安排告訴航空公司。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One email, coming right up.
dialogue.zh: 一封郵件，馬上就發。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the spirit, one step at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈspɪrɪt wʌn stɛp æt ə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 對了，一步一步來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, is the wifi working?
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ ɪz ðə ˈwaɪˌfaɪ ˈwɜːrkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，這裡的無線網路能用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Password is on your key card holder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpæswɜːrd ɪz ɑːn jʊr ki kɑːrd ˈhoʊldər/
dialogue.zh: 密碼印在你的房卡套上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I will update tracking now.
dialogue.zh: 好，我現在就去查追蹤頁面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope the page turns green today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp ðə peɪdʒ tɜːrnz ɡriːn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 希望頁面今天能變綠燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It just says searching, still.
dialogue.zh: 頁面上還是顯示尋找中。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Searching is normal for day two.
dialogue.zh: 第二天顯示搜尋中很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bought socks again at your shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɔːt sɑːks əˈɡɛn æt jʊr ʃɑːp/
dialogue.zh: 我在你們商店又買了一次襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add it to your receipts pile.
dialogue.zh: 把那張也放進收據堆裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pile grows like a snowball.
dialogue.zh: 那堆收據像雪球越滾越大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big pile, bigger refund, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 說不定堆越大，退得越多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will number each photo of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈnʌmbər iːtʃ ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 我會給每張收據照片編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The claims team loves neat people.
dialogue.zh: 理賠團隊最愛有條理的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The airline desk gave me a kit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛrˌlaɪn dɛsk ɡeɪv miː ə kɪt/
dialogue.zh: 航空公司櫃台給了我應急包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice; what did they put in it?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wɑːt dɪd ðeɪ pʊt ɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不錯啊，裡面放了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A toothbrush, paste, soap, deodorant.
dialogue.zh: 牙刷、牙膏、肥皂、除臭劑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any clothes in that small bag?
dialogue.zh: 那個小袋子裡有衣服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A T-shirt, and fresh underwear too.
dialogue.zh: 一件T恤，還有乾淨內衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Airline kits save awkward mornings.
dialogue.zh: 應急包拯救了尷尬的早晨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They asked me to sign for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ æskt miː tu saɪn fɔːr ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他們讓我簽收了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Standard; the kit counts in the claim.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstændərd ðə kɪt kaʊnts ɪn ðə kleɪm/
dialogue.zh: 慣例而已，用品會計入理賠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So nothing is truly free, then.
dialogue.zh: 所以其實沒有什麼是白給的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps the total fair for both sides.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kiːps ðə ˈtoʊtl fɛr fɔːr boʊθ saɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 這樣雙方的總額才公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tracking page finally shows a scan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtrækɪŋ peɪdʒ ˈfaɪnəli ʃoʊz ə skæn/
dialogue.zh: 追蹤頁面終於顯示了掃描記錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where does it say your bag is?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʊz ɪt seɪ jʊr bæɡ ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 上面說你的行李現在在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One line: arrived at your city.
dialogue.zh: 只有短短一行：已抵達貴市。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a happy dance is allowed.
dialogue.zh: 那就可以開心跳個舞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It also says delivery tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 上面還寫著明天送達。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? The file never went cold.
dialogue.zh: 看吧，案子從未冷掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight I sleep like a baby.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我能像寶寶一樣睡著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost; the case is not closed yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔːlˌmoʊst ðə keɪs ɪz nɑt kloʊzd jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，不過案子還沒完全結。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello? Yes, this is the guest.
dialogue.zh: 喂？是的，我是住客。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good news; your big bag is here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd nuːz jʊr bɪɡ bæɡ ɪz hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 好消息，您的大行李箱到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are joking! It is really here?
dialogue.phonetic: /juː ɑːr ˈdʒɑːkɪŋ ɪt ɪz ˈrɪli hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你開玩笑吧！真的到了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The airline left it at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛrˌlaɪn lɛft ɪt æt ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 航空公司剛剛把它放在前台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you bring it up to my room?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn juː brɪŋ ɪt ʌp tuː maɪ rum/
dialogue.zh: 能幫忙送到我房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, a bellhop in two minutes.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，禮賓兩分鐘後到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was fast! Come in, come in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz fæst kʌm ɪn kʌm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好快！請進來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, the big blue case.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz ðə bɪɡ bluː keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 就是這個，藍色的大箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is mine! The ribbon is here!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz maɪn ðə ˈrɪbən ɪz hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 是我的！紅絲帶還在！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the tag number first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə tæɡ ˈnʌmbər fɜːrst/
dialogue.zh: 我先核對一下吊牌編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, here is my stamped report copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr hɪr ɪz maɪ stæmp rɪˈpɔːrt ˈkɑːpi/
dialogue.zh: 當然，這是蓋了章的報告副本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It matches. The wheels roll just fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈmætʃəz ðə wiːlz roʊl dʒʌst faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對得上，輪子也還很順。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, hard shells survive rough hands.
dialogue.zh: 好，硬殼經得起粗魯搬運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please open it up and check inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz ˈoʊpən ɪt ʌp ænd tʃɛk ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 請打開來檢查一下裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, one corner is badly cracked.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ wʌn ˈkɔːrnər ɪz ˈbædli krækt/
dialogue.zh: 不好，有個角落裂得很厲害。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me; I will write it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ miː aɪ wɪl raɪt ɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 給我看，我記錄下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they throw it again?
dialogue.zh: 他們又亂扔行李了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy bags fall sometimes; I am sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi bæɡz fɔːl ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz aɪ æm ˈsɑːri/
dialogue.zh: 重箱子偶爾會摔，對不起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside, my shoes are crushed flat.
dialogue.zh: 裡面的鞋子被壓扁了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least the shoes took the hit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ət liːst ðə ʃuːz tʊk ðə hɪt/
dialogue.zh: 至少鞋子擋了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will photograph every scratch.
dialogue.zh: 每道刮痕我都要拍照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart; photos win damage claims.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，照片是破損理賠的關鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The camera is safe, thank goodness.
dialogue.zh: 相機沒事，謝天謝地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always carry the camera by hand.
dialogue.zh: 相機一定要隨身帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lesson learned, I did hear you.
dialogue.zh: 我學到了，之前你提醒過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better late than losing it forever.
dialogue.zh: 遲學總比永不找回來好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, about this broken corner.
dialogue.zh: 現在說說這個破損的角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You have ninety days to claim.
dialogue.zh: 你有九十天的申請期限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety days, but I fly Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 九十天是夠長，可我週日起飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can file the claim from home.
dialogue.phonetic: /juː kæn faɪl ðə kleɪm frʌm hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 你回家也能提交申請。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I start that claim?
dialogue.zh: 那個申請要怎麼開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your reference number online.
dialogue.zh: 在網上用你的參考編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fill another long form?
dialogue.zh: 又要填一張長表格？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one is shorter, I checked.
dialogue.zh: 這張短多了，我剛看過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos, the report copy, and the tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz ðə rɪˈpɔːrt ˈkɑːpi ænd ðə tæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 照片、報告副本，還有吊牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly; upload all three today.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，今天把三樣都上傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I choose repair or money?
dialogue.zh: 我該選維修還是賠錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Repair if cheap; otherwise take cash.
dialogue.zh: 修得便宜就修，否則拿現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A new case costs a lot.
dialogue.zh: 一個新行李箱很貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We pay used value, not new.
dialogue.zh: 我們按折舊價值賠，不按新品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same rule as the camera.
dialogue.zh: 跟相機那條規則一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You learn this system fast.
dialogue.zh: 你對這套制度上手真快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I buy a new case tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ baɪ ə nuː keɪs təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚能先買個新箱子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep receipts, you know the drill.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kiːp rɪˈsiːts juː noʊ ðə drɪl/
dialogue.zh: 可以，收據留好，你懂的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, photo plus paper.
dialogue.zh: 當然，照片加紙本都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The signed kit counts too, remember.
dialogue.zh: 記著，簽收的應急包也計算在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The claim page asks for bank details.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kleɪm peɪdʒ æsks fɔːr bæŋk dɪˈteɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 申請頁面要銀行資訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enter the account in your own name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛntər ði əˈkaʊnt ɪn jʊr oʊn neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 填你本人名下的帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card number will do, right?
dialogue.zh: 我銀行卡的號碼行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we need a bank account.
dialogue.zh: 不行，需要銀行帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One minute, opening my app.
dialogue.zh: 稍等，我打開銀行程式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time; I am right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr taɪm aɪ æm raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，我就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sent! The status says received.
dialogue.zh: 發出去了！狀態顯示已收到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Payment takes seven to ten days.
dialogue.zh: 打款大約需要七到十天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next week I get my money back.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst wiːk aɪ ɡɛt maɪ ˈmʌni bæk/
dialogue.zh: 下週我就能拿回錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That covers the damage and the shopping.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈkʌvərz ðə ˈdæmɪdʒ ænd ðə ˈʃɑːpɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 破損和購物的花費都會一起賠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, plus the hotel laundry.
dialogue.zh: 對，還有飯店的洗衣服費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Laundry counts while the bag was late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɔːndri kaʊnts waɪl ðə bæɡ wʌz leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 行李延誤期間洗衣費也算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You people really helped me.
dialogue.zh: 你們真的幫了我大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is what our desk is for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz wʌt ˈaʊər dɛsk ɪz fɔːr/
dialogue.zh: 我們櫃台就是為這個設的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The weekend was tough, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過這個週末夠折騰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yet your trip is saved now.
dialogue.zh: 但你的旅行被救回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday's trip will start clean.
dialogue.zh: 週日回家的路會輕鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh shirt from the hotel laundry?
dialogue.zh: 是飯店洗的那件新襯衫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, returned exactly on time.
dialogue.zh: 對，分秒不差地送回了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small services keep big promises.
dialogue.zh: 小服務兌現大承諾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My daughter asks about her drawing.
dialogue.zh: 女兒在問她那張畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The books and the drawing came too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʊks ænd ðə ˈdrɔːɪŋ keɪm tuː/
dialogue.zh: 書和畫都一起到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She will be so happy.
dialogue.zh: 她肯定會非常高興。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Art has no price, remember?
dialogue.zh: 畫作無價，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You found everything that matters.
dialogue.zh: 你們把所有要緊的都找回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost; did you check the jar?
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，那個藥罐查了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I almost forgot the medicine jar.
dialogue.zh: 我差點忘了那罐藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it too? Sealed and safe?
dialogue.zh: 也找到了？封好沒灑？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sealed tight, nothing spilled inside.
dialogue.zh: 擰得緊緊的，裡面一點沒灑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then truly nothing else is missing.
dialogue.zh: 那就真的什麼都不缺了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me count my small items.
dialogue.zh: 我再數一遍零碎東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush at all; we have time.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rʌʃ æt ɔːl wiː hæv taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 不用急，時間還早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Socks, T-shirt, razor, all here.
dialogue.zh: 襪子、T恤、刮刀，全在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That covers every basic need.
dialogue.zh: 基本所需全都齊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even the soap cost money.
dialogue.zh: 連那塊肥皂也是花錢買的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Claim it with the other receipts.
dialogue.zh: 和其他收據一起報銷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, checked twice and sent.
dialogue.zh: 辦好了，查了兩遍才提交。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the file can close soon.
dialogue.zh: 那這個案子很快就能結。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the payment seems short?
dialogue.zh: 如果到手的錢看起來少了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call the number on your copy.
dialogue.zh: 打你副本上那個電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved that number already.
dialogue.zh: 那個號碼我早就存了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are organized now, my friend.
dialogue.zh: 你現在可有條理了，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You were patient with my panic.
dialogue.zh: 我慌亂時你一直很有耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone panics; night flights test us.
dialogue.zh: 誰都會慌，紅眼航班折騰人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I pack light.
dialogue.zh: 下次出行我輕裝上陣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light bags make happy travelers.
dialogue.zh: 行李輕，旅客開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And lenses ride inside my jacket.
dialogue.zh: 鏡頭會揣在我的夾克裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you sound like a pilot.
dialogue.zh: 這話聽起來像機長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I tip you for all this?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tɪp juː fɔːr ɔːl ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 能為這一切給你小費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our policy says no, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 我們規定不收，心領了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then a kind review online.
dialogue.zh: 那我就在網上寫個好評。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That would truly help our team.
dialogue.zh: 那真的會幫到我們團隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, and thank you again.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，再次謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a safe Sunday flight home.
dialogue.zh: 祝你週日回家的航班一路平安。
